purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Kancheepuram District's official Survey & Land Records office documents digitized urban/Natham records and FMB sketches, while the official district land-services page links Tamil Nadu's Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR workflow. The linked service host timed out for a bounded anonymous request, so no safe native parcel identity plus polygon was verified, no GeoJSON sample was retained, and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Local Kancheepuram district Survey and Land Records custody is evidenced by the official district page and office details; state-level Tamil Nadu land-record service custody is evidenced by the official district service page and National Government Services Portal. These establish relevant registry custody but not an open Kanchipuram parcel-vector service.

officialPrimarySources.operator: District Survey and Land Records Office, Kancheepuram, Government of Tamil Nadu
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official page states that Natham and urban land records are computerized, digitized FMB sketches are uploaded, online land-record management is implemented, and gives the district survey-office contact/location.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Kancheepuram District Administration, Government of Tamil Nadu
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official service page lists Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, Patta verification and Poramboke verification, and links eservices.tn.gov.in.

officialPrimarySources.operator: National Government Services Portal / Government of India
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official service description says Tamil Nadu land records can be queried by district and rural/urban administrative selections, including town, block, ward, survey and subdivision for urban areas.
Official TNGIS portal presents public GIS applications and Kanchipuram context; no parcel feature response was obtained.

searchQueries.result: Official district Survey & Land Records, district land-services, Government Services Portal and TNGIS sources found; no verified public parcel vector endpoint.

attempts.attempt: Official district Survey & Land Records and land-services page inspection
attempts.result: HTTP 200 pages retrieved. District custody, digitized record scope and linked public land-record workflow were verified; no parcel geometry response was exposed in the pages.

attempts.attempt: Bounded anonymous GET to linked Tamil Nadu e-Services host
attempts.result: eservices.tn.gov.in timed out after 20 seconds. No TLS exception, login, token-value use, CAPTCHA bypass or unsafe query was attempted.
Official TNGIS public portal and Tamil Nadu map references were found; no current machine-readable Kanchipuram parcel service configuration or safe geometry response was verified.

geometryDecision.details: No full parcel polygon and no verified stable cadastral/survey native identity were obtained. No exact-point hit or miss was used to infer coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kancheepuram District Survey & Land Records, linked Tamil Nadu e-Services, Government Services Portal description, TNGIS, and Tamil-language official map discovery.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public service documentation and local/state custody evidence only; parcel geometry, schema, CRS and citywide extent remain unverified.

remainingUncertainty: The official interactive Tamil Nadu land-record/TamilNilam/TNGIS workflows may expose Kanchipuram-scoped geometry after administrative selection; current machine-readable availability is unknown.
